name: Goblin
description: Goblins are small, wiry creatures that lurk in dark places and ambush unwary travelers.

statBlock.instinct: To take what they can get
statBlock.moves:
Ambush from shadows
Call for reinforcements
Flee when outnumbered

name: Goblin War Rider
description: Goblins mounted on wolf-back, swooping across the plains to terrorize travelers.

statBlock.instinct: To harry and harry until the prey falls
statBlock.moves:
Ride past and attack
Lead foes into ambush
Kick their wolf into a frenzy

name: Goblin Shaman
description: The spiritual leader of a goblin tribe, calling on dark powers to bless raids and curse enemies.

statBlock.instinct: To bind spirits to goblin will
statBlock.moves:
Cast a hex
Summon spirit helpers
Disappear into shadow

name: Orc Warrior
description: Hard-muscled warriors who paint their bodies before battle and fight with brutal efficiency.

statBlock.instinct: To die in glorious battle
statBlock.moves:
Press the attack ferociously
Knock aside armor
Fight to the last breath

name: Orc Bloodwarrior
description: The most fearsome of orc fighters, capable of entering a blood frenzy that makes them near unstoppable.

statBlock.instinct: To destroy everything weaker than themselves
statBlock.moves:
Enter a frenzy: ignore injuries, deal +damage
Knock down and trample
Roar to terrify weaker foes

name: Orc Shaman
description: Calls upon the dark gods of the orc clans, drawing power from blood and sacrifice.

statBlock.instinct: To strengthen the clan through dark ritual
statBlock.moves:
Curse an enemy
Summon ancestral spirits
Call lightning from a clear sky

name: Skeleton
description: The animated remains of the dead, kept moving by necromantic energy and an empty will.

statBlock.instinct: To follow orders from beyond the grave
statBlock.moves:
Continue fighting through mortal wounds
Assemble into formation
Rattle bones to unsettle foes

name: Skeleton Archer
description: Animated bones that wield bows with mechanical precision, never tiring, never missing cover.

statBlock.instinct: To rain arrows on the living
statBlock.moves:
Volley from cover
Kite retreating foes
Collapse cover with massed fire

name: Zombie
description: Rotting corpses shuffling forward driven by necrotic hunger, silent and relentless.

statBlock.instinct: To consume the living
statBlock.moves:
Grab and hold
Absorb damage and keep coming
Rise again after being felled

name: Ghoul
description: Once a person cursed for desecrating the dead; now a ravenous, paralysis-inflicting predator.

statBlock.instinct: To feast on the freshly dead
statBlock.moves:
Paralyze with a touch
Digging up graves to feed
Move swiftly through tunnels and ruins

name: Wight
description: A warrior bound by dark oaths beyond death, retaining some intellect and terrible purpose.

statBlock.instinct: To serve the oath that bound them
statBlock.moves:
Drain the life from a victim's eyes
Command lesser undead
Announce an ancient grievance

name: Lich
description: An ancient wizard who sacrificed their own soul to cheat death, now nearly immortal and immeasurably powerful.

statBlock.instinct: To pursue eternal power and knowledge
statBlock.moves:
Cast a devastating ritual spell
Drain life force with a touch
Reveal that death cannot stop them
statBlock.tags: Solitary, Undead, Magical, Divine, Terrifying, Amorphous

name: Vampire
description: An ageless predator wrapped in aristocratic grace, the vampire feeds on the blood of the living.

statBlock.instinct: To seduce, dominate, and feed
statBlock.moves:
Charm a victim into compliance
Drain blood and regain health
Transform into mist or wolves
Command their thralls

name: Cave Rat
description: Fat rodents the size of small dogs with matted gray fur and yellow, too-long teeth.

statBlock.instinct: To gnaw on everything
statBlock.moves:
Overwhelm a lone target
Spread disease with a bite

name: Stirge
description: Blood-drinking flying pests with a trumpet-like snout — an annoyance to some, deadly in a swarm.

statBlock.instinct: To feed on warm blood
statBlock.moves:
Attach and drain blood
Swarm around a victim in a cloud

name: Dire Wolf
description: A massive predatory wolf the size of a cart horse, with thick black fur and glowing amber eyes.

statBlock.instinct: To bring down large prey
statBlock.moves:
Howl and call the pack
Knock prey to the ground
Harry a target until it can't flee

name: Cave Bear
description: Enormous prehistoric bears that make their lairs in deep cavern systems.

statBlock.instinct: To defend its territory
statBlock.moves:
Pin prey under an enormous paw
Roar to shake the stalactites
Rake with powerful claws

name: Giant Spider
description: A spider the size of a horse, spinning webs that can trap a man whole.

statBlock.instinct: To trap and feed
statBlock.moves:
Entangle in sticky webbing
Hang from the ceiling and drop
Inject paralyzing venom

name: Giant Scorpion
description: An armored arthropod the size of a horse, with crushing claws and a deadly venomous stinger.

statBlock.instinct: To crush and sting
statBlock.moves:
Grab with pincers and sting repeatedly
Knock down with a tail sweep
Pursuit through rocky terrain

name: Troll
description: A massive, regenerating creature of hunger with crude intelligence. Fire and acid alone stop its healing.

statBlock.instinct: To eat everything, always
statBlock.moves:
Regenerate from wounds before the foe's eyes
Smash with enormous fists
Fling rocks from a great distance

name: Ogre
description: A lumbering, brutish giant that smashes first and thinks never. Lives to fight and eat.

statBlock.instinct: To break things and take what it wants
statBlock.moves:
Hurl a boulder at a distant target
Knock enemies off their feet
Use a smaller creature as a club

name: Cyclops
description: A one-eyed giant with poor depth perception but terrifying strength.

statBlock.instinct: To guard what it has claimed
statBlock.moves:
Throw boulders wildly
Herd creatures like sheep
Panic when surprised by more than one direction

name: Ankheg
description: A car-sized insectoid that burrows under farmland and sprays acid on prey.

statBlock.instinct: To burrow, ambush, and devour
statBlock.moves:
Burst from the ground beneath a foe
Spray acid in a wide arc
Drag prey underground

name: Owlbear
description: What magic birthed this abomination? Half bear, half owl, all violence.

statBlock.instinct: To find and destroy prey
statBlock.moves:
Hold prey in a crushing grip
Shriek loud enough to disorient
Scent prey through walls and doors

name: Minotaur
description: A bull-headed warrior with supernatural strength and a perfect sense of labyrinthine space.

statBlock.instinct: To guard its labyrinth and its rage
statBlock.moves:
Charge with unstoppable momentum
Gore and toss with powerful horns
Know exactly where prey is in its maze

name: Basilisk
description: A low, slow reptile whose gaze turns flesh to stone — one of the oldest and most feared curses.

statBlock.instinct: To turn all it sees to stone
statBlock.moves:
Gaze: petrify a creature
Bite through stone-hard flesh
Lumber toward prey without hurry

name: Manticore
description: A lion with a human face and a tail covered in venomous spikes it launches at prey.

statBlock.instinct: To hunt and consume humanoid prey
statBlock.moves:
Rain spikes from the sky
Dive and rend with lion claws
Taunt prey with unsettling human-like speech

name: Harpy
description: Part woman, part vulture, harassing and luring prey with a terrible song.

statBlock.instinct: To lure, claw, and torment
statBlock.moves:
Sing to lure the unwary
Mob a target in a shrieking cloud
Carry prey to a great height and release

name: Hydra
description: A seven-headed serpentine predator that grows two heads for every one that is cut off.

statBlock.instinct: To consume everything within reach
statBlock.moves:
Attack with multiple heads at once
Grow back severed heads
Constrict a victim under its coils

name: Wyvern
description: A lesser dragon kin with two legs and powerful wings, its venomous stinger tail as deadly as its jaws.

statBlock.instinct: To prove dominance over other fliers
statBlock.moves:
Dive from the sun to strike
Plunge the venomous stinger deep
Bear aloft and drop prey from height

name: Black Dragon
description: A swamp-dwelling dragon of cruelty and acid, hoarding misery as much as treasure.

statBlock.instinct: To corrupt and destroy beauty
statBlock.moves:
Spit a stream of corroding acid
Breath acid in a wide cone
Dive below dark water and attack from beneath
Let minions fight while watching

name: Red Dragon
description: The greatest and most feared of dragons, a creature of fire and towering pride.

statBlock.instinct: To dominate and be feared
statBlock.moves:
Breathe a torrent of fire
Demand tribute and respect
Fly to a height and survey the burning landscape
Crush with its claws
statBlock.tags: Solitary, Huge, Dragon, Terrifying, Amorphous, Magical

name: Demon Soldier
description: A lesser demon conscripted into an army from the Abyss — vicious, brutal, and nearly mindless.

statBlock.instinct: To corrupt and destroy
statBlock.moves:
Surge forward in a mindless charge
Ignore wounds from lesser weapons
Drag a soul back to the Abyss

name: Balor
description: A massive demon general trailing fire and wielding a flaming sword and lightning whip.

statBlock.instinct: To lead the hosts of Hell to victory
statBlock.moves:
Strike with the flaming sword
Ensnare with the lightning whip
Explode in a fiery death, damaging all nearby
Command lesser demons

name: Imp
description: A tiny devil that serves a master, carrying messages, spying, and tempting mortals.

statBlock.instinct: To corrupt and report
statBlock.moves:
Sting with a venomous tail
Go invisible to spy
Whisper temptations in a sleeping ear

name: Bandit
description: Desperate or greedy road agents who prey on travelers in lawless lands.

statBlock.instinct: To take what others have earned
statBlock.moves:
Surround and threaten
Ambush from the treeline
Flee when the odds turn

name: Bandit King
description: The charismatic or terrifying leader of a large bandit gang, with military experience.

statBlock.instinct: To rule through fear and cunning
statBlock.moves:
Rally the gang
Offer a deal, then betray
Duel personally to prove dominance

name: Cultist
description: True believers willing to die — and kill — for a dark power they only half understand.

statBlock.instinct: To serve the dark patron
statBlock.moves:
Fight with fanatical disregard for safety
Attempt a ritual sacrifice
Summon something worse

name: Dark Priest
description: A servant of dark gods who wields divine power corrupted by ambition and cruelty.

statBlock.instinct: To spread the will of their patron
statBlock.moves:
Curse an enemy with their god's displeasure
Heal allies by drawing life from enemies
Command undead

name: Mud Golem
description: A hulking construct of animated earth that returns to a pile when destroyed — until someone makes it again.

statBlock.instinct: To protect what it was made to protect
statBlock.moves:
Engulf a creature in its mass
Reform from seeming destruction
Fling clods of earth

name: Clay Golem
description: A humanoid construct of hardened clay, slow but nearly indestructible.

statBlock.instinct: To follow its creation orders exactly
statBlock.moves:
Crush with enormous hands
Ignore injuries and keep walking
Berserk when injured by lightning

name: Shadow
description: A creature of pure darkness born when someone dies in total despair. It drains life just by touching.

statBlock.instinct: To engulf all light
statBlock.moves:
Emerge from a target's shadow
Weaken with a cold touch
Hide in absolute darkness

name: Crocodilian
description: A massive, armored reptile lurking in murky swamp water, completely still until prey is in reach.

statBlock.instinct: To ambush and drag prey under
statBlock.moves:
Drag prey beneath the water
Death roll to break bones
Lay perfectly still until the last moment

name: Swamp Troll
description: A hungrier, fouler troll from the swamps, reeking of decay and bristling with moss and fungi.

statBlock.instinct: To devour whatever crosses its swamp
statBlock.moves:
Regenerate and stand back up
Vomit a stream of acid bile
Drag prey into deep water

name: Will-o'-Wisp
description: A ghostly light that lures travelers into bogs and drowning pits, feasting on their despair.

statBlock.instinct: To lead the living to ruin
statBlock.moves:
Lure with a beckoning light
Shock with lightning when touched
Vanish when in danger
statBlock.tags: Solitary, Tiny, Flying, Stealthy, Undead, Magical

name: Gnoll
description: Hyena-headed raiders touched by demonic power, who roam in frenzied war packs leaving nothing alive.

statBlock.instinct: To rampage and consume
statBlock.moves:
Ravage a fallen enemy
Howl to draw more gnolls
Fight harder when it smells blood

name: Centaur
description: Half human, half horse — proud warriors of the open plains who defend their tribal lands.

statBlock.instinct: To defend the old ways
statBlock.moves:
Charge with a lance
Hurl a javelin from horse-speed
Kick with crushing hooves

name: Mummy
description: An ancient priest or noble preserved and bound by ritual to guard a tomb forever.

statBlock.instinct: To protect what it was bound to protect
statBlock.moves:
Curse with rotting disease
Paralyze with fear
Call for others to help guard the tomb

name: Death Knight
description: A paladin brought back by oath-breaking and dark power, clad in black armor radiating cold dread.

statBlock.instinct: To serve the oath of destruction
statBlock.moves:
Smite with unholy energy
Call upon hell-fire in a burst
Rally undead minions to its banner
statBlock.tags: Solitary, Medium, Undead, Warrior, Magical, Terrifying

name: Treant
description: An ancient tree given will and voice. They war against those who burn the forest.

statBlock.instinct: To protect the ancient forest
statBlock.moves:
Uproot and hurl a tree
Grapple with animated branches
Call beasts and plants to help

name: Unicorn
description: A horse of pure magic whose horn can heal or kill. Protects sacred forests with divine wrath.

statBlock.instinct: To purge corruption from its woods
statBlock.moves:
Charge and impale with the horn
Heal the worthy with a touch
Call lightning on the corrupt

name: Blink Dog
description: A dog-like fey creature that teleports short distances to evade and flank its quarry.

statBlock.instinct: To run down and disrupt
statBlock.moves:
Teleport to flank
Bite and vanish
Coordinate with pack through barking
